record_notes.DCP-LETT-451: Catalogue paraphrase embeds three genuine Darwin quotations, followed by his valediction. Only those quoted spans and paragraph 2 are voice eligible; proof descriptions in the paraphrase are context. No incoming proof note survives.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-454: Sends further Birds proofs and asks about Latin accents. Editorial dating uses the stage of work after the Emma letter; preserve the inferred header without treating publication chronology as receipt evidence.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-508: Requests Anthus skins and a stuffed bird following a forgotten measurement yesterday, evidently contact rather than an identified letter. Embedded Falkland specimen notes concern earlier collecting, not composition. Broad June-October 1839 Tuesday interval retained.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-528: Malcolmson answers an unlocated Darwin enquiry with extensive observations and quotations about India, Malacca and Arabia. Glen Roy paper is still expected. Later use in Coral reefs or Notebook A does not date Darwin receipt to July 24.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-533: Incomplete Malcolmson letter distinguishes Darwin former letter taken on tour from his latest received one. Baggage was delayed ten days and the Glen Roy paper had not arrived. Multiple missing Darwin inputs remain unlocated; 1836 observations are not composition dates.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-535: Malcolmson transmits Hardie notes dated 1830 and reports Dr Allan holds Darwin latest enquiry. Hardie quotation is embedded third-party voice. Glen Roy paper and Beagle volumes remain expected. No surviving Darwin input or dated outgoing witness identified.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-559: Incoming fragment comments on pages of Journal of researches. After October 7 is an editorial assumption based on expected book receipt, not a known Darwin receipt date. Raw upper bound extends beyond the period; remains held.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-548: Corrects the prior account of Aldabra back to coral, reports a prospective Allan letter and coral growth claim. The promised letter and actual chart loan are not yet established. November 30 is composition, not Darwin knowledge activation.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1147: Malcolmson proposes Robertson and acknowledges receiving Glen Roy paper a few days earlier. Body is incomplete and its last paragraph is physically above the salutation. Darwin later co-signature on the certificate does not establish full letter reading on January 2.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-581: Thanks Gray for his book and requests completion of Gould manuscript after repeated illness. Book is the received object; no covering letter is established. Friday window November 20-December 11 retained.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-587: Queries a species-name alteration in proofs. Final publication retained the earlier name, but that later outcome must not enter this question. Proof exchange is not an extant incoming letter pair.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-589: Requests index checking, promises Errata proofs and seeks return of specimens. Broad February-March 1841 Saturday retained; no incoming identified.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-11313: Short ointment order to either Baxter. Entire 1842-1882 range remains held; later botanical uses do not date this order.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-8132: Carbonate of ammonia order dated only the second. Website header reaches April 1882 while CSV/XML end March 1882; preserve the discrepancy and keep held.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-13776: Orders distilled water, camphorated spirits and perfume, dated only the tenth. Recipient father-or-son remains unresolved; later uses do not establish an 1842-1843 date.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1768: Asks Baxter to act on an enclosed note and send two bottles. Enclosure is missing and original authorship unknown. Disjoint year alternatives retained; not an inferred incoming training prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-11271F: Ointment order on December 8 in 1842-1881; no year chosen and no separate incoming evidence.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-13772F: Spirits of wine order on March 16 in 1843-1882; no year chosen or medical purpose inferred.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-13772: Ink recipe request on March 21 in 1843-1882. Editorial identification through Herbert book is background, not a demonstrated letter input or exact year.
